description: r87 (B200, mit_normal_gpu, one run per GPU, seed 0 only): an early end-to-end look at r86's arm 'muon1338m_s14180' a day before the 11-18 box, same config otherwise. Read by final dev against the other r87 arm on the same GPU type (paired seed 0); B200 results are not gated. r86 text follows. r86 (11-18 8x H100 AWS box, track D, RL only, three runs per GPU, vllm_gpu_memory 0.08): D 006's RL settings (shaping 0.5, lr 6e-6, self-imitation 64 rows coef 0.5 by level, constrain_batched), step-capped with no time stop: budget_steps maps step s to (s-1)/budget_steps of time_budget_s for the schedules, so the run matches an H200 run of that length. 11441 steps = r77 seed 0's H200 count in D 006's 14040 s; 14180 = the same rate over r81's 17400 s. U19/U16 as r81: Muon lr 4e-3 checkpoints at 1.338B tokens (H200 56 min) and the freed 56 min spent on RL (14180 steps). Read by final dev against the control in the same batch. H100 results are not yet gated.
